name: qualified-binary-reservation-audit-20261004
purpose: Bounded two-source metadata review; the qualified tier covers unverified entity mapping only, not a waiver of prior source-origin/freshness holds.

primary_rights.approval_basis: Explicit primary UCI277 CC-BY-4.0 grant; OpenML's host license badge is not the basis.
primary_rights.scope: Metadata-only reservation now. Later local research only after an explicitly qualified cohort freeze/release; no clinical deployment, reidentification, hosted-row sharing or additional redistribution approval.
primary_rights.obligations: Retain source/contributor attribution and disclose retrospective collection, native coding, class imbalance and unresolved independent-patient mapping.

timing_and_entity_review.collection: Retrospective Wroclaw Thoracic Surgery Centre cases for major lung resections for primary lung cancer in2007-2011; part of the Polish National Lung Cancer Registry.
timing_and_entity_review.endpoint: Original binary one-year outcome, OpenML Class1=death within one year after surgery, Class2=survival; same native Risk1Yr meaning. No relabeling, transformation or alternative horizon.
timing_and_entity_review.predictors: Diagnosis, FVC/FEV1, Zubrod status, documented pre-surgery pain/haemoptysis/dyspnoea/cough/weakness, clinical tumour-size category, diabetes/MI/PAD/smoking/asthma and age at surgery.
timing_and_entity_review.no_target_components: The reviewed16predictor fields contain no death/survival indicator, one-year outcome component, follow-up length or other result target. No postoperative survival proxy is inserted.
timing_and_entity_review.timing_limit: This is retrospective record-level annotation classification, not an established baseline prognostic or clinical-use model. PRE19's 'MI up to6months' wording is retained without inventing a precise reference-time definition for it or a universal feature-availability cutoff.
timing_and_entity_review.entity_limit: Primary metadata calls instances individual patients, but identifiers/record linkage needed to independently certify patient-disjointness are not provided. The qualified tier, not a verified-entity claim, applies.
timing_and_entity_review.known_boundaries: No supplied patient/group/time keys or mandatory split constraints are discarded. Original official source splits remain intact; any experimental IID3 override requires a separately frozen protocol.

metadata_profile.basis: Primary descriptive counts and official OpenML metadata only, no payload recomputation.
metadata_profile.warning: Metadata size/class eligibility is not proof of later fold support. Existing official10fold minority tests are expected to have7rows; a later required>=10 test margin needs an explicit allowed IID3 experiment policy and actual checks, never an implicit replacement.

V1.meaning: Diagnosis - specific combination of ICD-10 codes for primary and secondary as well multiple tumours if any

V3.meaning: Volume that has been exhaled at the end of the first second of forced expiration - FEV1 (numeric)

V10.meaning: T in clinical TNM - size of the original tumour, from OC11 (smallest) to OC14 (largest) (OC11,OC14,OC12,OC13)

Class.meaning: 1 year survival period - (T)rue value if died (T,F)

pending_review.name: QSAR biodegradation
pending_review.rights: Primary UCI CC-BY-4.0 reverified; no license blocker was inferred.
pending_review.source_fact: Primary metadata identifies NITE/Japan biodegradation values and the Milano QSAR group, with molecular descriptors and a native experimental ready/not-ready binary endpoint.
pending_review.remaining_issue: The existing registry/audit explicitly withholds independent-origin status because chemical-origin overlap with already exposed QSAR Fish (UCI504/tabarena-46954) is unresolved. This metadata review does not prove mirror identity or disjoint compound histories either way.
pending_review.scope_boundary: Do not automatically broaden the unverified-entity tier exception into a waiver of a recorded cross-source origin/freshness hold. Different task IDs or endpoints do not by themselves settle that hold.
pending_review.resolution_needed: Primary evidence resolving source/compound lineage, or an explicit parent decision on how cross-source overlap is handled in a separately qualified claim. No compound payload comparison is performed or implicitly authorized here.

prior_records.hold_reason: UCI primary CC-BY-4.0 grant and native target are known, but chemical-origin overlap with selected QSAR fish remains unresolved. Not merged as identical and not counted as another independent admitted origin.

ledger.query: SELECT family_id,run_id,role,created_at FROM exposure ORDER BY family_id,run_id

exposure_audit.freshness_limit: No recorded thoracic source/mirror match was found. Unknown exposure remains unknown until a future formal release audit; no independent-patient or pretraining guarantee.

prior_top_level.name: benchmark-family-exposure-registry-v1
prior_top_level.policy: One runnable variant per family in each suite. Metadata inspection is not an unexposed-family audit. Unresolved origins remain separate provisional identities, never fresh confirmation.

current_exposure_snapshot.policy: Current exposure overrides historical declarations. Active candidate reservations prohibit acquisition until explicit parent release; historical manifests remain unchanged.

future_evaluator_requirement: Existing controllers bind specific cohorts. This inventory is not execution authority; any future run must explicitly bind this source, qualified tier and permitted experiment split policy without weakening source/group/rights checks.
